newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Serial Systems gets approval for Singapore listing.
newsitem.headline: Serial Systems gets approval for Singapore listing.

text.p: Electronic component distributor Serial System Pte Ltd said on Monday it had won approval in principle for a listing on the Stock Exchange of Singapore.
Serial System said in a statement it intended to list on the SESDAQ second board.
The initial public offering of shares would be lead managed by United Overseas Bank Ltd, the statement said.
It gave no details of the percentage of the capital of the company to be offered, nor the amount it hoped to raise.
Serial System recorded net profits of Singapore $7.4 million in 1996 on a turnover of S$184.3 million.
